prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["What is your companion's vibe?", "Select personality traits to tailor how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "Energetic, Calm, Curious, Playful", "Continue"]
1: ["Select Your Journey", "Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet or create a custom pet companion.", "Ready Pet vs Custom Pet"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Here is how to summon, move, and interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Click pet to interact | Drag to move | Right-click for options menu", "Start Playing"]
3: ["Preparing your desktop pet's animations and sounds...", "Waking Up Your Pet...", "Your pet is getting ready to jump onto your desktop screen!", "Almost ready..."]
4: ["Save & Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Sign in to keep your pet, items, and progress synced securely across all your desktop devices.", "Using the same account ensures your pet is never lost."]
5: ["Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your screen or minimize it to the tray.", "Building high-resolution pet animations..."]
6: ["Use bright lighting and clear front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation results.", "Upload clear photo", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Avoid blurry photos."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop companion a unique name to seal the adoption!", "Enter pet name...", "Certified Companion"]
8: ["Takes less than 2 minutes to complete your pet adoption!"]
9: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Complete these quick steps to get started with your pet on your desktop screen.", "1. Feed your pet | 2. Try dragging pet | 3. Minimize to system tray", "Complete Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting photos of the user.
Creates urgency to complete the onboarding process quickly.
